brief.concept: A 75-second vertical social launch film that introduces Propeller Picks at a high level: who it is for, what it is, where and when to use it, and how it turns player-prop research into a more informed and enjoyable experience without promises of outcomes.
brief.primary_question: What is Propeller Picks, who is it for, and how can sports fans use it to make player-prop and fantasy research more informed and more enjoyable?
brief.audience: Sports fans discovering Propeller on vertical social, including DFS, pick'em, and MLB fantasy users.
brief.learning_outcome: Viewers understand that Propeller is an independent AI-assisted research workspace for web and mobile, can inspect the reasoning behind a directional read, and can start in the free public Analyzer.
brief.cta: Start with the free Prop Analyzer at https://propellerpicks.com/analyzer/.
brief.freshness_requirements: Use current product captures where available. Any reused July 2026 product screen must be visibly labelled as an illustrative product capture. Do not use win-rate, ROI, profitability, agent-count, or promotional-availability claims.

script.evidence: User approved the social launch-film script.
